Appendix “A” Page 1 of 8
CITY OF RED DEER
ELECTRIC LIGHT & POWER DEPARTMENT
DISTRIBUTION TARIFF
Effective Date 1 This Tariff is effective on March 1, 2026. It applies to all consumption, whether estimated or
actual, on and after March 1, 2026 for the use of System Access and Distribution Access
services.
Terms and Conditions 2 The “Terms and Conditions for Distribution Access Services” and the “Terms and Conditions
for Retail Access Services” are part of this Tariff. Furthermore, the “Schedule of Fees for
Distribution Access Services” and the “Retail Access Service Agreement” are also part of this
Tariff.
Billing Demand 3 The kVA of Billing Demand with respect to the monthly billing period will be the greater of:
(a) the highest kVA Metered Demand in the monthly billing period; or (b) the highest kVA Metered Demand in the 12 consecutive months including and ending with
the monthly billing period. 4 The kVA Metered Demand will be measured by either a thermal demand meter having a
demand response period of 90% in 15 minutes and a 30 minute test period, or 15 minute
interval demand metering equipment. 5 The kVA of Billing Demand will be re-established on such shorter periods of time as designated
by the Utilities Manager for the individual customer as warranted by that customer's changing
load characteristics.
Transmission Rate Rider 6 On a quarterly basis, the Utilities Manager (or designate) will:
(a) Monitor the Alberta Electric System Operator’s transmission costs.
(b) Establish an appropriate adjustment to account for variances between estimated and actual
provincial transmission costs.
(c) Notify the General Manager, Operations of the calculated adjustment.
(d) Subject to the General Manager’s approval, ensure the adjustment is accurately reflected in
the Distribution Tariff.

schedule_d_pages.text:
APPENDIX “D” Page 1 of 5
THE CITY OF RED DEER
ELECTRIC UTILITY
REGULATED RATE TARIFF
Effective Date and Term 1 This Tariff is effective on March 1, 2026 and remains in effect until revised.
Terms and Conditions 2 The “Terms and Conditions for the Regulated Rate Tariff”, the “Terms and Conditions for
Distribution Access Services” and the “Terms and Conditions for Retail Access Services” are
part of this Tariff. Furthermore, the “Regulated Rate Tariff Fee Schedule”, the “Distribution
Access Services Schedule of Fees”, and the “Retail Access Service Agreement” are also part
of this Tariff.
Billing Demand 3 The kVA of billing demand with respect to the monthly billing period will be the greater of:
(a) the highest kVA metered demand in the monthly billing period; or (b) the highest kVA metered demand in the 12 consecutive months including and ending with
the current monthly billing period. 4 The kVA metered demand will be measured by either a thermal demand meter having a
demand response period of 90% in 15 minutes and a 30-minute test period, or 15-minute
interval demand metering equipment. 5 The kVA of billing demand will be re-established on such shorter periods of time as designated
by the Utilities Manager for the individual customer as warranted by that customer's changing
load characteristics.
Acknowledgement of Regulated Rate Tariff 6 In accordance with the Rate of Last Resort Regulation, Alta Reg 262/2005, when setting the
regulated rate tariff the Utilities Manager (or designate) will:
(a) notify the General Manager, Community Services of the calculated regulated rate tariff;
and
(b) the General Manager, Community Services will provide acknowledgement of the new
regulated rate tariff.

APPENDIX “D” Page 2 of 5
RESIDENTIAL REGULATED RATE RATE 61
7 This tariff is provided in accordance with the Rate of Last Resort Regulation, Alta Reg 262/2005,
and the Electric Utilities Act, S.A. 2003, c. E-5.1.
Application 8 Applies to all residential premises which:
(a) are measured by a single meter and contain not more than two dwelling units; and
(b) are not currently enrolled under any other price options or with any alternative retail
electricity supplier. 9 Rate:
(a) Administration Charge: $0.3035 per day.
(b) Energy Charge as per Regulated Rate Tariff Energy Price Setting Plan, Appendix “C” of
this Bylaw.
(c) System Access Charge as per Distribution Tariff, Appendix “A” of this Bylaw.
(d) Distribution Access Charge as per Distribution Tariff, Appendix “A” of this Bylaw.
Balancing Poll Allocation 10 As per Distribution Tariff, Appendix “A” of this Bylaw.
Transmission Rider 11 As per Distribution Tariff, Appendix “A” of this Bylaw.
Local Access Fee 12 As per Distribution Tariff, Appendix “A” of this Bylaw.
Minimum Monthly Charge 13 As per Distribution Tariff, Appendix “A” of this Bylaw, plus any applicable Administration
Charge, plus any applicable Balancing Pool Allocation.

APPENDIX “D” Page 3 of 5
GENERAL SERVICE REGULATED RATE RATE 63
14 This tariff is provided in accordance with the Rate of Last Resort Regulation, Alta Reg 262/2005,
and the Electric Utilities Act, S.A. 2003, c. E-5.1.
15 Application:
(a) Applies to a non-residential customer, or to a residential premise not entitled to Rate 61,
or to the “house lights” service (including common area lighting and utility rooms) of apartment buildings, where the kVA metered demand is less than 50 kVA. If the kVA
metered demand exceeds 50 kVA, Rate 64 will be applied immediately and will be
continued to be applied irrespective of future kVA metered demand; and
(b) It is reasonably forecasted that the annual consumption of electricity with respect to each separate property will be less than 250,000 kWh; and
(c) The customer is not currently enrolled under any other price options or with any
alternative retail electricity supplier. 16 Services are to be taken at one of the following nominal voltages:
(a) 120/240 Volts, single phase, 3 wire;
(b) 120/208Y Volts, network, 3 wire;
(c) 120/208Y Volts, three phase, 4 wire;
(d) 347/600Y Volts, three phase, 4 wire.
17 Rate:
(a) Administration Charge: $0.3035 per day.
(b) Energy Charge as per Regulated Rate Tariff Energy Price Setting Plan, Appendix “C” of
this Bylaw.
(c) System Access Charge as per Distribution Tariff, Appendix “A” of this Bylaw.
(d) Distribution Access Charge as per Distribution Tariff, Appendix “A” of this Bylaw.
Balancing Pool Allocation 18 As per Distribution Tariff, Appendix “A” of this Bylaw.
Transmission Rider 19 As per Distribution Tariff, Appendix “A” of this Bylaw.
Local Access Fee 20 As per Distribution Tariff, Appendix “A” of this Bylaw.
Minimum Monthly Charge 21 As per Distribution Tariff, Appendix “A” of this Bylaw, plus any applicable Administration
Charge, plus any applicable Balancing Pool Allocation.
